reviews.author: Tony Cabello
reviews.text: I understand people always hesitate to try a new barber or a new shop, and it’s especially hard when you’re not a local and have nothing to lean on except reviews. This place was awesome. Barbers were professional, knew exactly what I wanted and gave me a great cut. I look and feel great. Got a medium skin fade w/ Manuel and I would recommend to anyone.

reviews.author: Niels Kerkmans
reviews.text:
Excellent barber. I got my hair cut by Manuel and he delivered exactly what I asked for.

They are also very friendly and you get a massage at the end as well. Would recommend to anyone looking for a haircut in Querétaro!

reviews.author: Daniela Radpay
reviews.text: Amazing service and very talented stylists! My boyfriend and I both got terrific haircuts. Bianca is a magician with long hair!

reviews.author: Don Kienholz
reviews.text: Great cut and shave! Mucho gracias!! Walked in and got a spot. Manuel’s attention to detail was appreciated and noticed!🐻🐻

reviews.author: Angel B
reviews.text:
Alan was the one in charge of my haircut. Excellent experience, he was very kind and patient. Everything used was of great quality, the protocol of attention was spot on, I felt pampered.

Definitely will comeback whenever needed.

reviews.author: Robert Hart
reviews.text: My room was large, quiet and comfortable. Good hit water. Nice colonial building with a lovely terrace overlooking the city. I dropped a star because the wifi didn’t reach the room and I felt it was a little overpriced. But, everything was clean and comfortable.

reviews.author: Sohail Desai
reviews.text: Nice place with a colonial vibe like much of Queretaro. Just needs polishing of the details to become a great place to stay. Close to many of the sights of Queretaro. The staff is friendly and helpful, making adjustments to the included breakfast to accommodate our dietary requirements.

reviews.author: Carlos Garcia
reviews.text: The place is comfortable even though rooms are a little bit small and hot. The place has a very comfy terrace in the roof were you can chill and enjoy the view of the city

reviews.author: Daniel Gamboa
reviews.text: Very kind and professional service from the staff. Room's OK, clean and neat. However the hallways are a bit small, so it gets noisy sometimes.

reviews.author: Alfonso Galindo
reviews.text: After staying many times with pets they no decide without warning after paying for room they will not accept pets.. and they don't want to refund rooms paid for...mark this hotel of where NOT to stay in queretaro..fyi no A.C
